name: Compressor replacement
tagline: The right compressor, fitted and charged properly
summary: Diagnosis and replacement of failed AC compressors with correctly matched units.
description: A failed compressor means no cooling at all. We first confirm the compressor is really at fault and not a capacitor, relay or PCB. If replacement is needed, we match the compressor to your unit's capacity, refrigerant and power supply, then braze, vacuum and recharge the system so the new compressor runs reliably.
suitable_for: Split, window, cassette, tower, ductable and package ACs
includes: Correctly matched rotary, reciprocating or scroll compressor
Current and pressure checks after start-up
signs: Outdoor fan runs but no cooling
Outdoor unit hums but doesn't start
Breaker trips as the compressor starts
Compressor is very hot or noisy

options.name: Rotary compressor (split / window)
options.detail: Most residential ACs up to 2 TR

process.title: Diagnosis
process.text: We test the winding, capacitor and controls to confirm the fault.

process.title: Part matching
process.text: We source a compressor matched to capacity and refrigerant.

process.title: Replacement
process.text: Old compressor out, new one brazed in with nitrogen purging.

process.title: Charge & test
process.text: Vacuum, recharge and check pressure and current.

faqs.question: Is replacing the compressor worth it?
faqs.answer: On a newer AC in good condition, yes. On an old unit we'll tell you honestly if a new AC makes more sense.

faqs.question: Is the compressor under warranty?
faqs.answer: Many brands cover compressors for 5 – 10 years. Share your purchase details and we'll check.
